global_caveats: These figures describe NIP-57 zap receipts accepted by zap.observer from its public-relay coverage, not every zap on Nostr.
A NIP-57 zap receipt is not independent proof that its Lightning invoice was real or paid.
zap.observer excludes self-zaps, so this series omits the closest Nostr analogue to a Stacker News boost.
The monitored relay set, rejection counts, exact sats cap, and complete validation implementation are not exposed by the API.
Category metrics are provider-defined and must not be summed because they may overlap and do not include every profile zap.

zap_receipt_count.definition: NIP-57 kind 9735 receipt events accepted by zap.observer in 24 hourly buckets for a completed UTC day.
zap_receipt_count.avoid_language: all Nostr zaps or confirmed Lightning transactions

total_zap_sats.definition: Sum of BOLT11 amounts assigned by zap.observer to accepted receipt events.
total_zap_sats.warning: This is zap-denominated receipt value, not independent proof of Lightning settlement.

average_zap_sats.definition: Total zap-denominated sats divided by accepted receipt count for the period.

note_zap_receipt_count.warning: Provider categories are not assumed to be additive.

episode_zap_receipt_count.definition: Provider-classified podcast boost receipts returned by show=episodes.
episode_zap_receipt_count.warning: Provider categories are not assumed to be additive.

track_zap_receipt_count.definition: Provider-classified Wavlake track zaps returned by show=tracks.
track_zap_receipt_count.warning: Provider categories are not assumed to be additive.

stream_zap_receipt_count.definition: Provider-classified NIP-53 stream zaps returned by show=streams.
stream_zap_receipt_count.warning: Provider categories are not assumed to be additive.
